raw_segments.text: Good, said Mowgli, staring round slowly. I see that ye are dogs. I go from you to my
own people if they be my own people. The jungle is shut to me and I must forget your talk
and your companionship. But I will be more merciful than ye are. Because I was all but
your brother in blood, I promise that when I am a man among men, I will not betray ye
to men as ye have betrayed me. He kicked the fire with his foot, and the sparks flew up.
There shall be no war between any of us in the pack.
But here is a debt to pay before I go. He strode forward to where Shere Khan sat blinking
stupidly at the flames and caught him by the tuft on his chin. Bagheera followed in case
Up, dog! Mowgli cried. Up, when a man speaks, or I will set that coat ablaze.
